To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the platform’s users are highly active and engaged in a variety of creative activities that include remixing.
the reuse of existing designs is an important driver of the number and quality (as measured by the number of downloads) of designs on Thingiverse.
remixing is (1) a form of innovation that is (2) enabled by the platform’s openness, (3) facilitated by the availability of remixing tools, and (4), performed by the community’s most active members.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of remixing for design innovation in the age of the Internet.
the role of remixing in design innovation processes and the factors that facilitate such processes on open innovation platforms.
remixing as a form of knowledge reuse and innovation in the context of open online platforms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reuse of existing knowledge in the form of remixes plays a crucial role in the creation of new ideas on the Thingiverse platform.
the platform is a highly dynamic and vibrant community of remixes.
remixing can indeed be considered a form of innovation and that the remixing process is characterized by the combination of two types of innovation, namely, incremental and disruptive innovation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
remixing can be seen as a form of knowledge reuse and innovation that is enabled and supported by a specific set of features and user profiles.
remixing is a powerful form of innovation in the digital world and that its potential can be leveraged by designing platforms in a way that encourages users to create remixes.
the remixing of digital designs can serve as a model for the study of the reuse and transformation of existing knowledge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
remixing is a powerful mechanism for the creation of novel designs and that the platform’s features can significantly influence the extent to which it is used.
remixing is a form of innovation in its own right, which can be facilitated by platform features and user incentives.
remixing is a powerful tool to foster innovation on design platforms and to create a vibrant community.
